A recurrent state cache cannot be rewound for free because the model’s internal memory is a live, mutable object that changes with every new token processed. Unlike a simple list of past inputs, this state represents the accumulated context of the entire conversation up to that point. To rewind, the system must either maintain a full history of every intermediate state (which consumes massive memory) or re-run the computation from the beginning to regenerate the correct state. This re-computation or storage overhead makes true rewinding expensive, not a zero-cost operation.
